note: The T1 micro suite (s44). `ops`/`ops_wolf` are the sweep counts for the C/Rust and wolf lanes; the harness allows them to differ, but the suite sets them EQUAL because every kernel's correctness sink chains across sweeps and unequal counts would make the lanes compute different values. Sizes are picked so the slowest lane (always wolf today) spends 150-400 ms under the clock; every lane's MAD is published so a reader can judge the faster lanes' timing resolution. `expert`: a hand-tuned expert.c exists. `wrapping`: a wrapping.lu X3 variant exists. `witness`: vectorization remarks are collected. `sink`: `float` compares with a relative tolerance instead of exactly.
